behaviors.assignee-options: Opening the Assignee filter shows Anyone, each person, and Unassigned with task counts.
behaviors.search-assignees: Typing a name in Find a person narrows the assignee options.
behaviors.combined-filters: With To do selected, choosing Priya Shah shows only her To do task.
behaviors.filter-unassigned: Choosing Unassigned shows only the unassigned task.
behaviors.assignee-empty-state: Choosing Ana Lima shows “Nothing assigned to Ana Lima yet” with a Clear filters control.
behaviors.clear-filters: Clicking Clear filters resets both filters and restores all four tasks.

history.notes: Locators use the toolbar controls and listbox options to avoid matching task-card controls. Counts and task names assume the fresh seed data supplied in the PR.
